name: descript-clone

scripts.app: npm run build --workspace apps/web && WEB_DIST=./apps/web/dist npm run server:prod
scripts.dev: npm run server & npm run web

//: server uses --watch, which restarts on ANY server file save. That kills
in-flight jobs (and on Windows re-parents rather than kills the ffmpeg
child). Use server:prod when a render matters.
dev chains with '&', which is POSIX-only. On Windows run server and web

app = the whole product as ONE process on one port: it builds the UI and then serves it from the API server via WEB_DIST, exactly the way the packaged desktop app does. No Vite, no proxy, and nothing that can half-die and leave the browser talking to a server that is not there. Use server + web instead when you want hot reload while editing the UI. POSIX-only (env prefix), like dev.

mcp = the MCP server Hermes (or any MCP host) connects to. It is a SEPARATE process from the app on purpose: if an agent breaks the server while editing code, the app dies but this does not, so the agent can still read logs, run tests and revert. Its tests are in the test glob above; apps/mcp/src/*.test.ts would otherwise never run.
